chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 416: The Mask Falls – Profound Yin’s Discovery & Ziling’s True Face
chapter_meta_description: Profound Yin hints at a grand plan after finding Blood-Jade Spider silk. Han Li, having escaped disaster, is lured back by Madam Fan’s promise of Divine Thunder Bamboo, only to meet a mysterious woman claiming to be Fairy Ziling’s true face.
og_title: The Mask Falls: A New Game Begins
og_description: A rare glimpse behind the villain’s mask and our protagonist’s cautious return to the game.
twitter_title: Han Li gets a new lead and a shocking reveal.
twitter_description: After a month in hiding, a promise of treasure and a hidden face pull Han Li into a new intrigue.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary and almost mythical technique said to be able to neutralize all Five Elements, considered by many to be an impossible fantasy.
An ancient and incredibly rare spirit insect; finding even a trace of its silk is a monumental event that can unlock new paths for a high-level cultivator.
The Sublime Sound Sect’s signature defensive treasure, known for its powerful protective capabilities.
A treasure map leading to a legendary treasure trove; fragments of it are highly sought after by powerful cultivators.
An extremely rare and sacred wood-type material prized for its lightning-attributed properties, used in crafting high-grade magical treasures.
